semantic_checklist.paper_evidence: The verified PDF is the 2022 Journal of Scientific Computing article, SHA-256 b18628ffc348d7aeec2da02efb989b6e012f0b0fae09b27fbff735bb8a5877cd. Relevant context is on PDF pp. 5-8 and 17-19.
semantic_checklist.lean_evidence: The declaration is specifically the Method 4s3pC printed-coefficient order certificate and uses the page-18 coefficient data.

semantic_checklist.paper_evidence: The paper's result belongs to an s-stage additive Runge-Kutta framework binding F, F_eps, epsilon, Delta t, stages, and solution/error quantities; Method 4s3pC has s = 4.
semantic_checklist.lean_evidence: The target is a closed proposition over Fin 4 real arrays. It binds no operators, step size, perturbation scale, state space, numerical solution, or error.
semantic_checklist.reasoning: Fin 4 correctly captures the coefficient dimension, but most binders and types needed for the paper result are absent.

semantic_checklist.paper_evidence: The global conclusions are conditional on stability and split according to whether tau is well behaved; the approximation model applies for relevant arguments y.
semantic_checklist.lean_evidence: The target has no binders or hypotheses and is only a closed conjunction of arithmetic facts.
semantic_checklist.reasoning: The conditional and quantified scope of the analytic result is not represented.

semantic_checklist.paper_evidence: PDF pp. 4-6 require F_eps(y)-F(y)=O(epsilon), distinguish bounded-derivative and nonsmooth cases, and condition global error interpretation on stability.

semantic_checklist.reasoning: The hypotheses governing both error branches are omitted.

rationale: The proposition is a correct, nonvacuous certificate that the literal page-18 coefficient display approximately satisfies all four third-order consistency equations and all nontrivial simplified smooth perturbation equations after b_eps is proved zero. It is nevertheless only a closed coefficient computation. It omits the additive algorithm, approximation and regularity hypotheses, stability, exact order satisfaction, and both smooth and nonsmooth global error conclusions. Thus the paper result entails the certificate, but the certificate does not entail the paper result, giving the classification not-faithful-weaker.
